title: MergeByDistanceNode rebuilds handle arrays after weld
description: Current line 44 preserves slots via withMesh but edge IDs change after welding, making handle arrays stale. Fix: after merge, rebuild _bezier_handles_start/_end arrays keyed by output edge IDs. For each output edge, locate corresponding input edge (by original vertex pair before welding) and copy handles.
definition-of-done: 1. After merge_by_distance on a handled mesh, handle arrays have length matching new edge count. 2. Welded seam vertices don't introduce handle artifacts. 3. Fallback when no handles.
testing-plan: 1. coons_patch->merge_by_distance->second coons_patch doesn't corrupt - handles consistent at seams. 2. Verify array size matches new edge count.
